TAL_BEASTMASTERY_DEFENSIVE_RIDER.why: An attack that targets your mount targets you instead: no Action, you must be riding it and remain a legal target (combat/ext/mount_guard.py through the retarget_attack hook; not while Meat Shield is up).

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_MEAT_SHIELD.why: The Bonus Action stays a compiled action (edge choice); the mount's Total Cover, Reactive Cover and the free End Meat Shield are combat/ext/mount_guard.py through the retarget_attack hook.

TAL_RETRIBUTION_HEAVEN_READING_STILLNESS.why: Adds one trigger to Counterstrike: a hostile creature within your reach begins any hostile action (combat/ext/counterstrike.py).

TAL_RETRIBUTION_TWO_ANSWERS_WITHIN_ONE_B.why: Two Counterstrikes a round, never two in one creature's turn, while Court of the Awaiting Blade is up (combat/ext/counterstrike.py).

TAL_RETRIBUTION_COURT_OF_THE_AWAITING_BL.why: The Domain stays a compiled Bonus Action (its aura zone); what it changes about Counterstrike is combat/ext/counterstrike.py: one additional trigger, regain Martial Focus once a round on a hit, the target cannot take Reactions.

TAL_RETRIBUTION_INTERCEPTING_STRIKE.why: Prepared: an interception is one of Counterstrike's choices (combat/ext/counterstrike.py). Its compiled Reaction stays: Reactive Interception, for Martial Focus.

TAL_RETRIBUTION_PATIENT_BREATH.why: A prepared Counterstrike that expires at the start of your turn without being used gives back Martial Focus (combat/ext/counterstrike.py).

TAL_SNIPER_INTERCEPTING_SHOT.why: Ready: Intercepting Shot per ranged weapon (combat/ext/intercepting_shot.py, the lock round's prepared hooks); the compiled Reaction stays as the Martial Focus use.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_MISDIRECTED_ATTACK.why: A successful Dirty Trick turns the Opportunity Attack on another legal target in the attacker's reach (combat/ext/redirect_reactions.py, the retarget_attack hook); the compiled reaction stays for the case with no other target.

tianxia.subpath.body.jujutsu.feature.har.why: The whole Reaction is played at the attack's declaration by combat/ext/redirect_reactions.py (the retarget_attack hook): save, then redirect / move / Prone on a failure, the damage reduction on a success. The compiled reaction row stays for its costs and numbers but never answers.

TAL_SHIELD_REDIRECTING_SHIELD.why: When a weapon attack misses you while your Active Defense is up against it, expend Martial Focus: the same roll against a new legal target in its reach or range, with the attack's own damage and effects (combat/ext/redirect_reactions.py, the after_miss hook).

TAL_SHIELD_PERFECT_REDIRECTION.why: Redirecting Shield also against spell attacks and Cultivation Attack rolls (combat/ext/redirect_reactions.py).
